by
  have h_finite : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∫ (y : E), y ∂μ ∈ E := 
    by rw [MeasureTheory.ae_eq measurableSpaceE]; 
      intro x; exact (MeasureTheory.integral_mem _ _).symm
  let f := fun x => x - ∫ (y : E), y ∂μ
  have h_f : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ E := h_finite
  have h_f_Lp : MeasureTheory.MemLp f p μ := h_Lp
  have h_id_Lp : MeasureTheory.MemLp id p μ :=
    by
      refine' MeasureTheory.MemLp.trans _ h_f_Lp
      intro x
      rw [MeasureTheory.mem_lp_iff_norm_le]
      rw [MeasureTheory.mem_lp_iff_norm_le]
      simp only [measure_theory.norm_sub, measure_theory.norm_id]
      exact (MeasureTheory.norm_sub_le _ _).trans (MeasureTheory.norm_add_le _ _)
